Needs changes before merge.

The guide covers the requested features and states the DXF and plasma recipe limits clearly. The three requested file compatibility barriers are present.

Local verification used a clean trial merge with upstream/main at 211105042b817a5b32fdf2c971d42e6d968297c6.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. It selects no Rust suites for these 14 documentation and Python files.
- `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_guide_refresh.py -v`: PASS, 12 tests.
- Zola 0.23.6 `zola build`: PASS, 48 pages, 10 sections, no orphan pages.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: PASS.
- Rust crate builds and clippy do not apply. No Rust crate changed. No GUI test ran.

Extra suites run:

- Full `site/tests` discovery with `ZOLA` set: 77 tests ran. It reports 15 failed subtests and six error subtests.
- The six errors require `node`, which is absent here. Fourteen failed subtests also fail with upstream main's guide content. They concern old tool-label checks and an old AI transport assertion.
- `test_guide_icons.py`: two tests pass; `test_operation_sections_and_guide_components_match_app` fails for PlasmaProfile. This failure is new in this PR. The same assertion passes with upstream main's page.
- No fixture or importer files changed. The extra kernel and importer suites do not apply.

Mutation checks: I restored each of the 12 changed guide pages to upstream main's content in temporary copies. Every mutation makes the coverage suite fail. Restoring each PR page makes all 12 tests pass again. No PR files changed during these checks.

Safety tier: not applicable. This PR changes no posted G-code, geometry, collision checks or stock simulation. No goldens moved. No crates/ui files changed, so before/after screenshots are not required.

Requested before merge:

1. `site/content/guide/operations/operations-plasma.md:41`: Keep the operation icon and schematic immediately after `## Plasma Profile`. The new recipe section precedes them and breaks the existing icon assertion. Move the recipe text below the icon, or give it a separate section that preserves the operation heading contract. Run `test_guide_icons.py` again.

   Failure text:
   ```text
   AssertionError: False is not true : operations-plasma.md ## Plasma Profile must start with {{ <icon name="op-plasma-profile" /> }}
   ```

2. `site/content/guide/reference/troubleshooting.md:468`: Remove the claim that AI Chat supports LM Studio. Every local panel preset maps to Ollama in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/transport_http.rs:27`. The panel has no endpoint field. A user who starts LM Studio cannot connect through these controls. State the panel limit and link to the existing `guide/automate/ai.md` page. That page already explains other runtimes and the external-agent route. Replace the pending #1949 pointer at line 476 with that guide link.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
